# jessica.is

> Jessica Phan is a product and brand designer and builder at heart. She helps founders and teams turn ambiguity into products, brands, and meaningful experiences.

## Identity
- Name: Jessica Phan
- Site: https://jessica.is
- Role: Product & Brand Design Consultant
- Strengths: product design, brand design, AI product design, design leadership, prototyping, front-end / builder instincts
- Contact: https://www.linkedin.com/in/jessicaphan/

## What she offers
- Product design consulting for early-stage through growth teams
- Brand design for product companies
- AI product design guidance (strategy, UX, shipping instincts)
- Design leadership advisory
- Writing and talks on design, work, curiosity, and craft

## Primary pages
- [Home](https://jessica.is/): Currently, Field Notes, and selected companies
- [Open to collaborating](https://jessica.is/open-to-collaborating): A letter from Jessica — open to collaborating with people building something
- [Jessica / About](https://jessica.is/jessica): Bio, values, fun facts, books, explore paths
- [Creating](https://jessica.is/creating): Selected work, companies, and experiments
- [Writing / Field Notes](https://jessica.is/writing): Essays on design, work, curiosity, and life
- [Talking](https://jessica.is/talking): Talks, workshops, and topics of interest now

## Selected proof
- Chan Zuckerberg Initiative / Learning Commons (AI infrastructure & education platforms)
- OpenSea (marketplace, mobile, brand)
- Sequoia Capital, Samsung, Vault.fm, Sound.xyz, NYU, Weee!, SAP, JCPenney, and more
